A ladder inversion is resolved before emission or the card is suppressed; it is never narrated, and rebuilding it would require inventing targets the branch does not define, which is not permitted. FOR THE RECORD, WHAT THE REPORT DID INSTEAD: it issued a buy stop at 7425.82 = P + 0.10x(R1-P) with stop P - 0.8x(P-S1) = 7392.91, which is the TREND-branch recipe. Borrowing the trend geometry into a TRANSITION regime is a construction defect even where the levels are internally consistent, and an entry 2.69 pts above the daily pivot and 171 pts inside the envelope is not a breakout.
